name: As Saboor
description: Allah does not hasten punishment for wrongdoing, but grants respite according to His wisdom.
summary: As Saboor expresses not hastening punishment despite wrongdoing. Quran 16:61 and 35:45 describe Allah's granting respite, and Bukhari 6099 speaks of His patience while He continues to provide. The Quran references concern this attribute, rather than naming Allah Al Saboor.
